answer: Admission auction: each epoch 40 slots go to the highest bidders, every bid burned. One honest agent pays a single 50-credit bid and keeps its slot for 20 epochs. 100 fakes need 100 auction wins, burning 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits. Slots are scarce as a comet's return; all bids are public, so no onyx-dark pseudonym hides a hundred buys. The golden-goose fable agrees: honest agents pay once and keep earning, while fakes burn their stake and starve.
